title: FindAdmissiblePathsRequest
description: Request body for findAdmissiblePaths (CQ7). Candidate paths MUST be generated over the time-indexed projection for ⟨profileId, at, policyId⟩ — never over an all-time graph filtered afterward (see spec/08).

profileVersion.description: Optional pin to an exact grounding-profile version. Omitted, the deployment resolves the current binding and reports it on the result. Supplied, the implementation MUST execute that version or fail rather than substitute another — this is what lets a `GroundedPath` be re-executed, not merely attributed.

at.description: Query time the projection is built for.

policyVersion.description: Optional pin to an exact admission-policy version, with the same contract as `profileVersion`.

predicateFamilies.description: Restrict traversal to these predicate families. Values are drawn from the ProfileVocabulary bound to the profile named in `profileId`; discover them with `getPredicateFamilies`.

limit.description: Maximum number of paths to return.
